mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM do not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%) does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both Real Final Sales (RSAFS) and Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 2% MoM, it signals strong consumer demand and housing market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2% MoM
failure_condition: If the joint condition (RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2% MoM) does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 2.5% YoY, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (INDPRO > 2% YoY and GDPC1 > 2.5% YoY) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
